---
title: "Cars - sliderInput"
format: dashboard
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
df <- mpg
empty_plot <- function() {
  plotly_empty() |> layout(title = list(text = "No cars match these inputs.", y = 0.5))
}
```

# Plots

## {.sidebar}

```{r}
sliderInput("displ", "Engine size", min = 1.6, max = 7, value = c(1.6, 7), step = 0.1)
```

## Column

```{r}
#| title: Engine size and highway mpg
plotlyOutput("p1")
```

```{r}
#| title: City mpg
plotlyOutput("p2")
```

# Data

```{r}
#| title: Cars
DTOutput("tbl")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
filtered <- reactive(df |> filter(displ >= input$displ[1], displ <= input$displ[2]))
output$p1 <- renderPlotly({
  if (nrow(filtered()) == 0) return(empty_plot())
  ggplotly(ggplot(filtered(), aes(displ, hwy)) + geom_point())
})
output$p2 <- renderPlotly({
  if (nrow(filtered()) == 0) return(empty_plot())
  ggplotly(ggplot(filtered(), aes(cty)) + geom_histogram(bins = 15))
})
output$tbl <- renderDT(datatable(filtered()))
```
